# FlowBuddy

> FlowBuddy turns one recorded walkthrough of a SaaS product into its whole user-education stack. A founder shows FlowBuddy their product once (a recorded demo); FlowBuddy learns how the software works — its workflows, its concepts, its screens — and turns that into a founder-approved knowledge layer (the application intelligence layer) embedded in the product with one script tag. That single layer powers the user lifecycle end to end: interactive user onboarding and contextual help & guidance to activate new users, an in-app AI assistant (with consented AI agent execution, in beta) for everyday help, and autogenerated product videos for training. Live in about 30 minutes, no coding required.

Key facts:

- The positioning, in one line: record your application once — onboard, guide and help every user from the same approved knowledge.
- The underlying concept is the application intelligence layer: a layer above a product's data, API and UI layers that understands how the product itself works, explained at https://flowbuddyai.com/application-intelligence-layer.
- Everything answers only from knowledge the founder recorded and approved. The assistant shows the source behind every answer and honestly says "I don't know yet" instead of guessing when something isn't covered.
- It is context-aware: it knows which page the user is on and can highlight the exact next step directly in the product's interface.
- Five live capabilities, named on the page as: **Interactive User Onboarding** (guides a user through a whole task, one step at a time), **Contextual Help & Guidance** (reads the page the user is on and highlights their next step), **In-App AI Assistant** (conversational help inside the product), **AI Agent Execution** — in BETA: the assistant carries out an approved workflow itself, but only when the founder has switched it on (off by default) and only with the end user's explicit consent; runs are narrated, stoppable at any time, and outcome-verified before reporting done — and **Autogenerated Product Videos** (a branded, narrated video derived from each approved workflow).
- The homepage maps these onto the user lifecycle in three stages: Activate (interactive user onboarding + contextual help & guidance) → Adopt (the in-app AI assistant + agent execution) → Train & Self-serve (product videos, step-by-step SOPs, help portal). In development and NOT yet fully available as standalone products: the **Autogenerated Help Portal**, **SOP Generation**, and **Third-Party Agent Access** (outside AI agents reading the approved knowledge).
- Setup: record a product demo with the FlowBuddy Chrome recorder → FlowBuddy automatically creates product knowledge and step-by-step workflows → the founder reviews and approves them → embed one small script tag to go live.
- Works with any web app. The assistant is a floating overlay and never changes the host product's pages or layout. Its accent color can match the host brand.
- Privacy and safety: sensitive data is masked in the browser during recording before anything is uploaded; the embed key is public-safe, restricted to allowlisted domains, and rotatable. In agent runs, sensitive values are always typed by the user directly into the product's own fields — they never pass through FlowBuddy.
- Pricing: free during early access; no credit card required.
- Outcomes it is bought for: higher activation, fewer support tickets, lower content cost (one recording replaces hand-built tours, docs, videos and SOPs), always-current help that updates with the product.

## Pages

- [Home](https://flowbuddyai.com/): record your application once — onboard, guide and help every user: the transformation (record your application → FlowBuddy learns it, you approve it → it powers every user surface) · the user lifecycle in three stages (Activate · Adopt · Train & Self-serve) with the capability each stage gets · how it works (record → approve → go live) · outcomes · FAQ
- [The Application Intelligence Layer](https://flowbuddyai.com/application-intelligence-layer): the concept behind the product — a new layer in the SaaS stack, above data → API → UI, that understands workflows, guides users, delivers support and powers AI agents; the definition of "application intelligence layer"; everything the layer powers
- [In-App AI Assistant](https://flowbuddyai.com/in-app-ai-assistant): the assistant capability in depth — grounded answers inside the product, sources shown, honest "I don't know yet"
- [Contextual Help & Guidance](https://flowbuddyai.com/contextual-guidance): the guidance capability in depth — page- and screen-aware help that highlights the next step in the product's own UI
- [Interactive User Onboarding](https://flowbuddyai.com/interactive-onboarding): the onboarding capability in depth — guided walkthroughs derived from a recording, advancing automatically across pages
- [AI Agent Execution](https://flowbuddyai.com/ai-agent-execution): the acting capability in depth — IN BETA: consented, narrated, stoppable, outcome-verified runs; off by default
- [FAQ](https://flowbuddyai.com/faq): the full question set — what FlowBuddy AI is, what an application intelligence layer is, and how it differs from chatbots, help centers and product tours; how it learns a product from one recording; setup and installation; accuracy, recording privacy and data handling; support-ticket, onboarding and activation impact; AI agent execution (beta) and where third-party agent access is heading
- [The road ahead](https://flowbuddyai.com/future): FlowBuddy's direction — the same approved intelligence layer opened to more consumers: a hosted help portal and third-party AI-agent access are in development (not yet available)

- [Create an account](https://app.flowbuddyai.com/signup): free during early access
- [Sign in to FlowBuddy Studio](https://app.flowbuddyai.com): the dashboard where founders record, approve, and configure their assistant
